workload_notes.needle: passkey retrieval, a prompt-retention probe; the answer is emitted within the first generated tokens, so a budget over the generated cache cannot move it
workload_notes.multistep: a fact chain whose later operands exist only in the generated trace, scored on the last integer written and on nothing about the reasoning

budget_semantics: every method in a cell is held to the same total_budget; generation_budget bounds the generated cache only, so a prompt-protected run holds prompt_length + generation_budget and the two numbers are never interchanged
decode_wall_seconds_note: Python-level wall clock, for bookkeeping only; not a throughput measurement
